notes: Stories created for Mongo query size estimation with full lifecycle coverage.

BL-0.1.4-009-S1.title: Define Mongo Query Size Estimation Contract
BL-0.1.4-009-S1.description: Define a schema and contract for estimating MongoDB query size including inputs (query object, projection, limits) and outputs (estimated bytes, risk level, threshold flags) aligned with GPT Reader constraints.

BL-0.1.4-009-S2.title: Implement Query Size Estimation Logic
BL-0.1.4-009-S2.description: Implement backend logic to estimate MongoDB query result size based on document count, average document size heuristics, and projection fields, with pre-execution evaluation to prevent oversized responses.
BL-0.1.4-009-S2.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (enforces response size cap and query limits)

BL-0.1.4-009-S3.title: Enforce Query Guardrails in GPT Reader
BL-0.1.4-009-S3.description: Integrate size estimation into GPT Reader query execution path to block, truncate, or adjust queries that exceed safe thresholds (e.g., auto-limit documents, enforce projection).
BL-0.1.4-009-S3.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (query execution, response caps, audit logging)

BL-0.1.4-009-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Query Size Estimation
BL-0.1.4-009-S4.description: Create tests validating estimation accuracy, threshold enforcement, and behavior under edge cases (large documents, wide projections, high cardinality queries).

BL-0.1.4-009-S5.title: Audit Logging for Query Size Decisions
BL-0.1.4-009-S5.description: Extend GPT Reader audit logging to capture estimated size, applied limits, and rejection/truncation decisions for observability and debugging.

BL-0.1.4-009.mitigation: Use conservative estimation heuristics and enforce existing hard caps (500KB, 100-doc limit).
